nodes.label: CDFG (Control Data Flow Graph)
nodes.description: Abstraction representing asynchronous concurrency in MLIR-AIR programs. Built via -air-dependency pass, used for scheduling optimization.

nodes.label: -air-dependency pass
nodes.description: Analyzes data and loop-carried dependencies, generates CDFG, updates program with AIR async operation interface.

nodes.label: -air-dependency-canonicalize pass
nodes.description: Removes redundant edges in CDFG using transitive reduction algorithm.

nodes.label: -air-dependency-schedule-opt pass
nodes.description: Performs scheduling optimization on CDFG; detects data broadcasting opportunities across spatially mapped AIE cores.

nodes.label: -air-dependency-parse-graph pass
nodes.description: Visualizes CDFG as .dot files using GraphViz, one per hierarchy level plus combined view.

nodes.label: Rationale: Transitive Reduction for CDFG Canonicalization
nodes.description: Redundant async dependency edges removed via transitive reduction because they do not represent dominant producer-consumer relationships.
